record.question: Which of the following forms of silica crystallizes in Monoclinic system?
record.explanation: The printed page 2 confirms the monoclinic stem and the same four options, including "Averturine". Milky quartz, rose quartz, rock crystal and aventurine are quartz varieties; quartz has trigonal symmetry (point group 32), not monoclinic symmetry, so none is defensible. A corrected stem or an option naming a monoclinic silica polymorph is needed; see https://www.handbookofmineralogy.org/pdfs/quartz.pdf.
